children: Italian banks' lending to non-financial companies accelerated in July, Bank of Italy data showed on Wednesday, rising by 4.1% year-on-year after a 3.2% increase in June.
Deposits held by residents at Italian banks rose 2.4% annually in July, from 2.8% the previous month, the central bank also reported.
Fundraising through bonds increased by 5.6% yearly in July, down from 6.0% in June.
